description: Non-secret ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi AT transcript capture plan. Each case records raw bytes and timing; it does not define a BL616CL expected response.

cases.summary: Capture scan framing, terminal response, and the immediate post-scan status with the ambient radio environment recorded as metadata.
preconditions: UNO R4 WiFi is running the ESP32-S3 baseline bridge firmware.
RA4M1 is running examples/ra4-at-transcript-proxy at 115200 baud.
Do not rely on the SSID, BSSID, RSSI, channel, or encryption rows being stable.
Keep the raw capture outside the repository because scan rows contain SSIDs and BSSIDs.

cases.summary: Capture the current Wi-Fi status code without changing the radio state.
preconditions: Record the connection state and the preceding test case in capture metadata.

cases.summary: Capture the runtime Wi-Fi mode readback.
preconditions: Record the current STA/AP connection state in capture metadata.

cases.summary: Capture the malformed STA connection error path without exposing a network credential.
preconditions: No network credential is required or allowed in this capture.
No radio state is changed by an invalid mode value.

cases.summary: Capture current automatic-reconnect state without modifying it.
preconditions: Record the current setting in the output; do not change it in this case.

cases.summary: Capture the deprecated automatic-connect readback; ESP32-S3 0.6.0 source statically returns false.
preconditions: This read is expected to be a deprecated ESP32 Arduino Core no-op on the 0.6.0 baseline.

cases.summary: Capture the deprecated automatic-connect enable write; ESP32-S3 0.6.0 source statically makes no persistent change.
preconditions: The ESP32-S3 baseline must be firmware 0.6.0 or a source-equivalent Arduino Core revision.
Do not reuse this case as evidence for another ESP32 core version without checking its WiFiSTA implementation.

cases.summary: Capture the deprecated automatic-connect disable write; ESP32-S3 0.6.0 source statically makes no persistent change.
preconditions: The ESP32-S3 baseline must be firmware 0.6.0 or a source-equivalent Arduino Core revision.
Do not reuse this case as evidence for another ESP32 core version without checking its WiFiSTA implementation.
